instruction: Cinematic film still, low-angle medium full shot. The man (R1) carries a light-colored surfboard under his left arm, looking forward with a slight smile. The boy (R2) walks beside him with his eyes squinted closed against the light. The scene is illuminated by strong, warm backlighting that creates a hazy, high-key atmosphere with prominent lens flare.
